jobs.title: Project Manager, Social Impact
jobs.description:
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is seeking a Project Manager to join our Program Management Office. The Project Manager has overall responsibility for managing scope, budgets, timelines, project teams, stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables across multiple projects that improve the lives of people living with diabetes. Reporting to the Program Director, this role supports the PMO in standardizing project management processes (with a focus on efficiency), ensuring strategic alignment and effective program delivery, and fostering collaboration across teams. The Project Manager will support ADA mission\-driven success on PMO initiatives and programs while promoting accountability and impact.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Leads cross\-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget
* Aligns resources to accomplish project tasks and key milestones with clear accountability for project deliverables
* Communicates and collaborates with development and marketing teams to provide training and information required to promote and seek funding for new projects, programs, and systems.
* Directs the work of a project team with overall responsibility for managing scope, budget, timeline, staffing and stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables.
* Accountable for project deliverables, overall project success, and supporting contract renewals to expand ADA’s offerings.
* Serves as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, volunteers, customers, and vendors.
* Maintains process documentation and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement for all organization initiatives.
* Facilitates quality management and change management techniques for project management.
* Effectively estimates and plans project resources, schedules, and budgets.

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree required
* Minimum expected years of relevant experience: 5 years in project management and/or delivery of programs, products, or services
* Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification is preferred
* Understanding of project management methodologies, such as PMBOK
* Demonstrated proficiency in project management software (e.g. MS Project or Smartsheets)

  


**Skills**


* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong sense of urgency
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to form and lead high\-performing teams
* Critical thinking and the ability to manage complex projects
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills
* Strong change management skills
* Demonstrates a high level of personal accountability and holds others accountable for results
* Fosters collaboration and cooperation to deliver results
* Strong planning, organization, and attention to detail
* Good negotiation skills
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work independently to manage multiple concurrent projects

  


**Why Work Here**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work\-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:


* Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
* A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
* Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability \& life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
* Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
* A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
* Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well\-being of millions

  


**About the Organization**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Healthcare
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager – Healthcare

**Client:** California State Govt  
**Position:** Senior Project Manager  
**Certification:** PMP – Required

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to support healthcare technology, data, and program initiatives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing complex **healthcare and government projects**, with strong knowledge of **Medicaid/Medi\-Cal, Medicare, HIPAA compliance, Electronic Medical Records (EMR/EHR), healthcare data analytics, and healthcare information systems**.

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* **PMP (Project Management Professional) certification – Required**
* 8\+ years of Project/Program Management experience managing large and complex initiatives.
* Strong **healthcare industry experience**.
* Demonstrated experience working with **State and/or Federal Government agencies**.
* Strong knowledge and project experience involving **Medicaid/Medi\-Cal and/or Medicare programs**.
* Experience working with **HIPAA compliance, healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory requirements**.
* Experience with **Electronic Medical Records (EMR) / Electronic Health Records (EHR)** and healthcare information systems.
* Strong experience with **healthcare data analytics, reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and data\-driven decision making**.
* Experience managing healthcare data initiatives involving areas such as:
* Medicaid/Medi\-Cal and Medicare data
* Claims and encounter data
* Member and eligibility data
* Provider data
* Clinical and operational healthcare data
* Data integration and interoperability
* Data quality and governance
* Analytics and executive reporting
* Experience managing cross\-functional teams consisting of healthcare business, technology, data, analytics, and vendor resources.
* Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end management of complex **healthcare technology, data, and analytics projects**.
* Manage initiatives supporting **Medicaid/Medi\-Cal, Medicare, and other government healthcare programs**.
* Coordinate projects involving **EMR/EHR systems, healthcare applications, data platforms, system integrations, and interoperability**.
* Ensure project activities align with applicable **HIPAA, privacy, security, State, Federal, CMS, and DHCS requirements**.
* Manage healthcare data analytics initiatives, including dashboards, reporting, KPIs, data quality, and executive\-level analytics.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, RAID logs, governance structures, and project documentation.
* Manage risks, issues, dependencies, scope, schedules, resources, and project deliverables.
* Facilitate meetings involving DHCS leadership, healthcare SMEs, technical teams, data teams, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Prepare executive\-level project status reports, dashboards, presentations, and recommendations.
* Manage multiple workstreams and ensure timely completion and acceptance of project deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of **Medi\-Cal and Medicaid programs**.
* Experience working with **CMS (Centers for Medicare \& Medicaid Services)** requirements and initiatives.
* Experience with **Medicare programs and healthcare regulatory requirements**.
* Knowledge of **HIPAA, PHI, healthcare privacy, security, and compliance**.
* Experience with **EMR/EHR platforms and healthcare interoperability**.
* Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards such as **HL7 and FHIR**.
* Experience with healthcare **Business Intelligence (BI), data analytics, dashboards, and reporting**.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Ting Data Products
jobs.description:
**About Ting Labs**

  

Ting Labs is the company behind Ting, an electrical fire prevention sensor active in more than 1\.3 million homes across North America. A single Ting sensor takes 30 million measurements per second; across the fleet, the result is one of the largest continuous, high\-resolution datasets ever assembled on the residential electrical grid.

  

Ting’s sensor fleet captures, in real time, what is actually happening on the grid downstream of grid\-side sensors. Utility operations and planning teams can use this distributed telemetry to improve the reliability and resilience of an electrical grid under unprecedented pressure. Ting Data Products is a new line of business that packages this data—through portals, APIs, files, dashboards, and other interfaces—for utilities and other institutional buyers who can put it to work. Visit tingfire.com for more information.

 **About the Role**


We are seeking a highly motivated Program Manager to manage the implementation, delivery, and ongoing customer success of Ting Data Products programs for electric utilities, government agencies, emergency\-management organizations, and other institutional customers.

  

This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role focused on making customer programs work. You will coordinate onboarding, product and data access, launch readiness, recurring program reviews, issue resolution, and ongoing delivery. Strong execution and a positive customer experience will be critical to the adoption and success of Ting Data Products.

  

You will serve as a day\-to\-day point of contact for customers and coordinate across Product, Engineering, Sales, subject\-matter experts, Marketing, Finance, and Operations. You will turn customer commitments into clear plans, track progress and open issues, and make sure the right people are engaged at the right time.

  

Customer needs will vary—from system\-level monitoring, event intelligence, and retrospective analysis to sensor\-level detail, and from use of the Ting Utility Grid Portal to APIs integrated into existing systems. This role is well suited to someone who is comfortable with technical products, enjoys customer interaction, and brings strong organization, judgment, and follow\-through.

  

The role reports to the Director of Program Management.

 **What You'll Do::**

* **Program delivery.** Manage the day\-to\-day delivery of customer programs from kickoff through launch and ongoing operation. Maintain clear plans, milestones, owners, action items, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
* **Customer onboarding and readiness.** Coordinate product access, data delivery, documentation, training, and launch\-readiness activities so customers are prepared to use Ting Data Products successfully.
* **Ongoing customer success.** Establish regular customer cadence, understand customer goals and use cases, track adoption, coordinate value reviews, and help customers get meaningful value from Ting data.
* **Customer support and issue resolution.** Serve as a responsive first point of contact for program questions and product issues. Triage requests, engage the appropriate technical or subject\-matter experts, communicate status, and follow issues through resolution.
* **Program health and reporting.** Monitor implementation progress, product usage, customer outcomes, risks, feedback, and open issues. Prepare clear updates for customers and internal stakeholders.
* **Cross\-functional coordination.** Bring together Product, Engineering, Sales, data infrastructure, subject\-matter experts, Marketing, Operations, and customer teams to keep work aligned and moving forward. Travel to client sites as business and program needs require.
* **Customer feedback and continuous improvement.** Capture customer needs, recurring issues, and product feedback; route insights to the appropriate internal teams; and help improve the product and customer experience over time.

 **What We're Looking For:**

* **Customer\-facing program experience.** 4\+ years of relevant experience in program management, implementation, customer success, consulting, product operations, or customer delivery within a B2B technology, SaaS, or data environment.
* **Relevant industry experience.** Experience supporting technology, data, or operational programs for electric utilities or similarly complex institutional or public\-sector customers. Direct electric utility experience is strongly preferred; experience with government agencies or emergency\-management organizations is a plus.
* **Customer\-success mindset.** You listen carefully, understand what customers are trying to accomplish, and take practical steps to help them adopt the product, and realize value.
* **Technical aptitude.** Experience working with data products, analytics platforms, APIs, enterprise software, or technical integrations. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable discussing data access, permissions, integration dependencies, and data quality with technical teams.
* **Strong program execution.** You can manage multiple workstreams, maintain clear plans and action items, identify risks early, and make sure commitments do not fall through the cracks.
* **Communication and judgment.** You are calm, credible, responsive, and comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders. You communicate clearly when work is on track and when issues arise, and you know when to resolve a matter directly versus escalate it.
* **Collaborative, hands\-on style.** You are equally comfortable leading a customer check\-in, coordinating access, preparing a status update, or working through the details of an implementation issue with internal teams.

jobs.title: Product Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Mammoth Brands**



Mammoth Brands (formerly Harry's Inc.) is the modern CPG company behind brands Harry's, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. We're building a new model—and home—brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples' lives, and ultimately challenge the status quo. Our mission is to "Create Things People Like More." Simply put: everything we do should be better than what already exists. If it's not, we don't do it. This guides everything we do, from developing the best product experiences, to making Mammoth Brands a great place to work, to exploring innovative ways to give back to our community.



We got our start in 2013 when our co\-founders created Harry's. They built the brand differently—online first, prioritizing direct relationships with customers—and in the process learned they'd created something bigger: a playbook and platform that could help other brands grow and scale to their full potential, and a vision to reimagine consumer packaged goods. Today, Mammoth Brands is a growing portfolio of brands and the largest CPG company built in the last 20 years. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: to create a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. As a company, we're also committed to making a positive impact and have donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.



We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day\-to\-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.



  

**About the team**



The Global Product Team is responsible for all aspects of product development and design from ideation through production. The team leads the company's largest product initiatives through the creation, development, and testing of innovative, high\-quality goods that will be sold to and experienced by customers all over the world.



Within the Product Team, the Program Management team is responsible for overall program scoping, driving cross\-functional teams to define and execute development and design strategy, and ensuring all workstreams ladder up successfully to launch new products.

  


**About the Role**



We're looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented leader who thrives in ambiguity and loves making things happen. This is an ideal role for someone eager to own big outcomes and grow within a fast\-moving product organization.



As a Product Program Manager, you'll lead cross\-functional workstreams and teams at all levels through thoughtful planning, execution, and support from concept through product launch. You'll manage a high volume of commercial initiatives and bundles. Success in this role means being a doer who brings structure, builds relationships, and drives momentum across functions.

  


**What you will do:**


* Drive execution across a high volume of product programs, primarily commercial and bundle initiatives, from scoping through launch
* Lead cross\-functional teams through development planning, timelines, and risk mitigation to ensure deliverables align with business goals
* Collaborate across product development, marketing, sourcing, operations, quality, finance, design, and sales to move work forward quickly and efficiently
* Work with domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers throughout development
* Clearly communicate updates, blockers, and decisions to stakeholders, including senior leadership, tailoring messages to different audiences
* Identify and implement workflow, tool, or process improvements that enable faster, more efficient execution


**This should describe you:**


* Bachelor's degree and 2\+ years experience in roles that require ownership, coordination, and execution. This can include rotational programs, operations, finance, or product development. Industry experience in CPG, startups, or fast\-paced environments a plus but not required
* No technical background required. We care more about your ownership, drive, and ability to get teams aligned and moving
* You are a self\-starter with strong judgment and a proven track record of accountability. You don't wait to be told what to do, and you're energized by figuring things out
* You bring structure to chaos by breaking down complexity, asking the right questions, and keeping others focused on what matters
* You communicate clearly and confidently across stakeholders, internal and external, senior and peer\-level
* You identify problems, own solutions, and take pride in driving outcomes rather than simply completing tasks
* You build trust quickly across teams, balancing input from multiple stakeholders while staying focused on the goal
* You are curious, adaptable, and resilient in the face of ambiguity, shifting priorities, or unexpected challenges
* You bring a positive outlook and a sense of humor. We take our work seriously and ourselves less so
  


**Here's who you'll work with:**


* Working on the Product Program Management team, which is part of the Global Product team
* Working closely with Product Development, Package Development, Marketing, Global Supply, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Sales, and Design teams as well as external supplier/vendor partners

  


**Benefits and perks**


* **Medical, dental, and vision coverage**
* **401k match**
* **Equity in Mammoth Brands**
* **Flexible time off and working hours**
* **L\&D stipend**
* **4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years**
* **20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood**
* **Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building even

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Company**



Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world\-class investors, operators, and sports \& entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next\-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

  


**Role Summary**



Fanatics Collectibles is seeking an Associate Project Manager (APM) to join its project management organization. These critical roles form the backbone of Fanatics Collectibles and are responsible for ensuring that 50\-75 new products are delivered to the market annually on\-time and in accordance with our high standards.



We are looking for strong leaders with a problem solving mindset, a disciplined execution first approach, who thrive in complex settings with multiple stakeholders, and who have a relentless ability to drive alignment and "run through walls" to get things done. A passion for sports and the sport collectibles and merchandise ecosystem is a very welcome plus.



Fanatics Collectibles is organized by sports vertical. The APM will report to the Director of Project Management (E\-Commerce) and is responsible for collaborating with a team domestically as well as internationally.

  


**Key responsibilities**


* **End\-to\-end ownership:** Responsible for contributing to the success and on\-time delivery of a complex global portfolio that encompasses over 75 programs annually. With a focus on tracking on\-time delivery of the team's highest value assets.
* **Vendor Management:** Act as a liaison between Fanatics Collectibles and vendor/partners. Schedule regular check\-ins. Hold all parties accountable for staying on task and on time.
* **Delivery roadmap:** Align and distribute a comprehensive timeline of milestones across the complete lifecycle of products internally and with external partners.
* **Performance management:** Track and manage the status of products in the current portfolio, ensuring that transitions between departments and vendors happen efficiently and keeping programs on track.
* **Problem\-solving:** Proactively identify upcoming bottlenecks, shifting priorities and convene stakeholders to problem\-solve and resolve them. Collaborate with subject matter experts to resolve escalations and complex issues.
* **Escalation:** Identify potential issues and preparematerials for escalation when needed.

  


**Desired skills \& abilities**

  


* Establish and maintain a **strong leadership presence** with the ability to influence overlapping stakeholders across complex organizations.
* **Attention to detail and strong organizational skills**, particularly in the ability to multi\-task and prioritize across a complex portfolio.
* **Data proficiency**, adept at interpreting data from multiple touchpoints. Identifying warning signs and predict long\-term trends that could affect future deliverables.
* **Strategic Judgement –** it is essential to balance competing demands, effectively allocate resources, and escalate issues appropriately to leadership.
* **Business judgment** balance competing demands and prioritizing requests for resources and escalation.
* **Cool under pressure** in dealing with unanticipated changes, last\-minute shifts, and unforeseen circumstances.
* Relentless focus on delivery and **"run through walls"** attitude toward execution.

  


**Education \& qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience in working in or managing a cross\-functional team across a fast\-paced environment.

  



Some travel may be required

  



Fanatics Collectibles is seeking leaders who are passionate about sports and committed to pushing boundaries the collectibles space. In this role you will have the opportunity to leave an indelible mark on the future of sports collectibles, working with world\-class teams to bring the next generation of products to market. You are not just filling a role; you are shaping the future of Fanatics.


*Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers*


By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and ack

**POSITION TITLE:** Project Manager


**LOCATION:** Hybrid, DMV


**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a High\-Risk Public Trust

  


**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  



At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission\-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low\-code/no\-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.



In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI\-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission\-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70\+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  


**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  


**POSITION SUMMARY**

  



The Project Manager is responsible for translating task\-order strategy into disciplined day\-to\-day execution for a federal health regulatory agency. The role integrates enterprise workforce training, regulatory reviewer and scientific development, learning\-system operations, data and compliance reporting, and modernization planning into one coordinated delivery model. The PM manages the operating rhythm, controls, and cross\-functional dependencies required in a regulated federal environment; provides continuity of leadership; and acts on the Program Manager's behalf when designated while preserving government approval and decision authority.

  

**DUTIES**

  


* Direct and coordinate daily APV task\-order operations across task areas, labor categories, workstreams, and authorized firm\-fixed\-price and time\-and\-materials activities
* Translate program priorities and client direction into integrated work plans, assignments, milestones, dependencies, staffing actions, and quality\-control checkpoints.
* Monitor schedules, labor utilization, deliverable status, service levels, risks, issues, decisions, and action items; identify variances early and coordinate corrective action
* Maintain operational cadence through team meetings, workstream reviews, integrated planning sessions, and concise status communications.
* Coordinate training intake and governance workflows, ensuring requests are documented, clarified, prioritized, assigned, tracked, and aligned with approved plans and decisions.
* Ensure coordination among instructional design, training delivery, scientific and regulatory SMEs, LMS operations, reporting, analytics, and administrative support.
* Support preparation and quality review of monthly status reports, weekly or ad hoc reporting, forecasts, dashboards, risk registers, staffing plans, meeting materials, and other management artifacts.
* Manage operational interfaces with client stakeholders, clarify responsibilities and dependencies, and elevate decisions requiring Program Manager or government authority.
* Support staffing continuity, onboarding, workload balancing, surge planning, succession coverage, and timely backfill of vacancies without degradation of service.
* Coordinate deliverable reviews to verify completeness, technical and instructional quality, accessibility, LMS compatibility, schedule compliance, and alignment with approved requirements.
* Support transition planning and continuity of mission\-critical learning operations during organizational, LMS, or federal human\-capital modernization changes.
* Act for the Program Manager when assigned and maintain continuity of communications, decisions, and accountability during the Program Manager's absence.
* Help ensure that APV personnel follow contract scope, security, privacy, records\-management, quality, and client governance requirements.

  


**FEDERAL HEALTH REGULATORY AND FUNCTIONAL EXPERTISE**

  


* Federal task\-order consulting and contractor operations, including scope control, client governance, performance oversight, auditable records, and clear separation of contractor recommendations from government decisions.
* Integrated management of enterprise learning content and delivery, reviewer and scientific workforce development, LMS administration, learning\-data reporting, and learning\-technology modernization.
* Program Management Plan and Integrated Master Schedule execution; milestone, dependency, staffing, utilization, performance\-variance, change, risk, issue, escalation, and corrective\-action management.
* Management of firm\-fixed\-price recurring operations and separately authorized time\-and\-materials, optional, surge, transition, or modernization work.
* Federal compliance and quality oversight spanning contractual requirements, security, privacy, records management, Section 508 accessibility, instructional integrity, technical compliance, LMS compatibility, and audit readiness.

  


**EDUCATION**

  



Bachelor's degree in business, management, public administration, human resources, organizational development, information systems, education, or a related field.

  


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  


* At least seven years of experience in federal program management or operations management.
* Demonstrated consulting experience managing work for a federal government health regulatory agency, another federal health or science organization, or a comparably complex regulated federal mission environment.
* Functional experience managing multidisciplinary services that include enterprise learning or workforce development, scientific or regulatory training, LMS operations, data and compliance reporting, or IT\-enabled human\-capital services.

**About the Department:**


Housing and Residence Life (HRL) is a self\-supporting auxiliary organization within the University Life unit of George Mason University. HRL serves a highly diverse population of approximately 6,200 students, the majority of which are undergraduates living in 40 traditional, suite, and apartment\-style residence halls in three campuses within the vibrant Northern Virginia area. HRL employs over 170 full\-time and graduate staff members and over 350 undergraduate student staff members. HRL is committed to providing a safe, well\-maintained student\-centered environment that is innovative and all\-inclusive of the global community. It is dedicated to creating a home that enriches the experiences of our students, staff, and faculty.


**About the Position:**


The Business Analyst (BA) position serves as a liaison between the Residential Services Assignments team and Housing Residence Life Finance team ensuring the accurate flow of residential student occupancy and billing data reflects on Mason finance systems. The Business Analyst utilizes the occupancy management platform to support data integrity, billing accuracy, and occupancy management processes. This position provides various monthly reconciliations for auditor reviews and develops revenue recognition solutions as needed. The Business Analyst also serves as the initial Housing Residence Life point of contact for audit coordination and compliance reporting at Mason and other state audit processes, and works collaboratively with departmental, divisional, and university finance personnel to ensure Housing Residence Life's revenues are accurate and aligned with university financial regulations. This position reports to the Director of Housing Residence Life Finance and Business Services and serves as a liaison to the Director of Residential Services in matters related to finance.


**Responsibilities:**


**Management, System and Data Analysis**


* Ensures accurate timing and processing of data transmissions related to room rental billing to ensure consistency in data reporting;
* Supports data accuracy efforts within the occupancy management platform by generating reports and reviewing data integrity;
* Collaborates and communicates with HRL IT and Residential Services staff to provide support for the housing management system from a financial perspective; troubleshoots technical issues and identifies needs within the system following established guidelines, creates manuals as needed, and implements long term plans for system improvements as appropriate;
* Advises the Chief Housing Officer (CHO), Director of Residential Services, and Director of HRL Finance and Business Services on the impact of business processes and makes recommendations for adjustments as needed according to payment and contractual processes in the HRL room rental application; includes consideration of historical contractual and occupancy changes and review of proposed changes to identify and address potential processing issues or financial concerns;
* Reviews, analyzes, and identifies areas for improvement for HRL's occupancy and financial reporting systems, documents current practices, and supports automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and data consistency;
* Conducts ad hoc analysis to investigate ongoing or singular operational issues and adjusts HRL processes in accordance with evolving institutional practices as needed;
* Creates informative, actionable and repeatable financial occupancy reporting to illustrate occupancy impact on the HRL budget and highlight relevant business trends and opportunities for improvement;
* Stays informed on changes to the housing management system through proactive professional development and attendance of related conference and training opportunities; and
* In collaboration with the Assistant Director of Assignments \& Applications Specialist, the Summer Operations Business Manager, and IT unit, develops and maintains financial system workflows, reporting tools, and dashboards to support the contracting, invoicing, payment, and posting/reconciling of Summer revenues from external clients to the university’s central financial management system; provides support and guidance for system transitions to Summer Operations colleagues.

**Finance**


* Performs monthly revenue reconciliations between databases to identify discrepancies in room rental revenues for the academic year and summer operations, and ensures proper documentation for audit purposes;
* Generates and distributes manual invoices for external groups utilizing Mason’s spaces for summer camps and conferences and follows up accordingly to ensure payments are received and posted accurately;
* Coordinates with HRL Summer Operations colleagues to support accurate and timely client billing and payment postings in the university’s central financial management system, ensuring financial accuracy and enabling efficient revenue collection;
* Collaborates with Mason Financial Planning and Analysis staff to help update coding in the Mason General Ledger Interface File, ensuring correct revenue postings from the housing management platform system to the university’s central financial management system;
* Supports the Director of HRL Finance and Business Services in monthly revenue forecasting and contributes to the preparation of HRL modeling

The Security Specialist IV provides high\-level technical expertise and analytical support for Department of Defense (DoD) security programs and program protection operations. Based on\-site at Fort Belvoir, VA, the specialist independently manages multi\-disciplinary security tracks across physical, personnel (PERSEC), industrial (INDUSEC), and operations security (OPSEC/Anti\-Terrorism) domains. **2\. Personnel \& Industrial Security Management (PERSEC / INDUSEC)**

* Coordinates and schedules biometric/fingerprinting requirements for newly onboarded or upgrading total force personnel requiring active background vetting.
* Validates, creates, and submits Visit Authorization Requests (VAR) directly within the Defense Information System for Security (DISS).
* Audits, processes, and tracks access provisioning requests via DD Form 2875 System Access requests utilizing automated frameworks like Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) and the Army Enterprise Systems Integration Program (AESIP).
* Manages facility access control pipelines, including reviewing and completing RTI39 Compound Badge Requests for on\-site personnel.


**3\. Foreign Travel Vetting \& Compliance**


* Pre\-screens, validates, and cross\-references clearance levels, mandatory foreign clearance training, country\-specific hazard maps, and visa requirements for personnel deploying on personal or official foreign travel.
* Operates the Aircraft Personnel Automated Clearance System (APACS) to secure organizational approval for international transit.
* Navigates DISS network criteria to upload, report, and maintain records for required foreign travel categories; conducts formal security debriefs and records completed travel closure statements in DISS upon return.
* Maintained total program compliance by reviewing and updating the Derivative Classification Training Certificate tracker in strict accordance with USD(I) Policy Memorandums.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


**Education \& Experience**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university.
* **Experience Baseline:** Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience managing multi\-disciplinary DoD security programs, program protection, or military intelligence environments.


**Technical Vetting Tools \& Systems**


* **Vetting \& Security Systems:** Full operational proficiency within DISS, PSIP, and APACS.
* **Access Management:** Hands\-on experience Routing DD2875 packets through digital channels, ICAM, and AESIP systems.
* **Security Frameworks:** Foundational knowledge of DoD Directive 5200\.01 (DoD Information Security Program), NISPOM, Derivative Classification parameters, and OPSEC metrics.
* **Communication:** Proven ability to respond to ad\-hoc security inquiries in a high\-tempo environment, provide clear policy guidance, and manage cross\-functional taskers.

**Location:** Zurich, Zurich, CH


Join a team of security and technology professionals and help Swiss Re to fulfil its mission in making the world more resilient.


We're looking for an experienced, forward\-thinking cybersecurity leader who will manage the production of detection content and incident investigation and help us to improve our incident response techniques. As a Cyber Security Analyst, you will be monitoring current threats by analysing and handling major cyber incidents, implementing standards and mentoring less experienced analysts.


What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup (50:50\), balancing work from home and the office premises (office presence required 2–3 days per week).


**About The Role**

Group Security \& Technology Platforms (GSTP) brings together security, technology platforms and operational resilience to provide secure, reliable and scalable foundations for Swiss Re's business. The function ensures that security, resilience and engineering quality are embedded by design into how technology is built, operated and evolved across the organisation.


You will be part of the Cyber Defence team – made of passionate individuals who keep the company safe by going above and beyond in terms of preciseness and diligence. We oversee the maintenance of security operations, focusing on delivering high\-quality detection monitoring and response solutions. Our team values innovation, collaboration and continuous learning, providing you with a stimulating environment to grow your expertise and make a tangible impact on our cybersecurity practises.


**In your role, you will perform:**


* Security monitoring – Oversee security operations, use advanced tools to monitor and analyse alerts, proactively detect incidents in real time, investigate and coordinate responses
* Incident response – Investigate security incidents, contain breaches and implement remediation strategies
* Operational excellence – Implement and maintain high operational standards
* Threat intelligence – Stay updated on cybersecurity threats and trends
* On\-call duty – Participate in on\-call rotations to address urgent matters outside of regular working hours
**What we need from you:**


Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of threat analysis and detection, we'll be more than happy to meet you!


* Experience in cybersecurity as a Security Analyst or Incident Responder (preferably in SOC/CSIRT setup)
* In\-depth knowledge of current threat landscape, offensive tooling and OWASP and industry\-standard security framework, such as MITRE ATT\&CK® techniques and Cyber Kill Chain
* Experience in malware and exploit analysis (or reverse engineering)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English
* Effective communication and presentation abilities to articulate and present complex security concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Ability to work well in a fast\-paced environment
**Nice\-to\-have:**


* Experience developing in Python, Kusto or any other scripting language
* Experience with Azure or Amazon AWS
* Experience with security tools and technologies such as SIEM, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP solutions

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.


In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance\-based bonus.


**About Swiss Re**


Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance\-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting\-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  

  

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Business Operations Analyst to join our LA based team! This is a graduate\-level opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants real ownership from day one. If you're a problem\-solving pro, an analytical thinker, a team player and can speak the language of data \- we want to hear from you!

**About ZURU**


ZURU is on a mission to disrupt across industries, challenge the status quo and catalyst change through radical innovation and automation advances. This is in play in different pillars of the company: ZURU Toys are re\-imagining what it means to play; ZURU Tech is shaping a better future by leading the next building revolution; ZURU Edge is pioneering new generation FMCG brands to better serve modern consumers.


Founded in 2003 by EY Entrepreneur of the Year and World Entrepreneur Hall of Fame brothers Nick and Mat Mowbray, ZURU has quickly grown to a team of over 5000 direct and indirect members across more than 30 international locations.


One of the largest toy companies in the world, globally recognized and award\-winning brands include Bunch O Balloons, Mini Brands, XSHOT, Rainbocorns and Smashers. Our global FMCG brands include MONDAY Haircare, Rascals, BONKERS, Gumi Yum Surprise, and more!


For more information, visit www.zuru.com

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Data \& Financial Analysis**

* Provide analytical support for retailer\-level sales performance and proactive SKU management.
* Build weekly, monthly and seasonal forecasts that drive growth and manage excess inventory.
* Maximise POS performance through in\-stock management and End of Selling Period inventory transition.
* Analyse and summarise item and brand performance, publishing your findings and insights to the wider business.
* Prepare ad\-hoc reports in response to business needs.
* Analyse product assortment and child\-level performance to recommend the optimal product mix.
* Research, analyse and publish relevant industry and market trends.
* Build and maintain Profit and Loss statements \- analysing revenue, cost and margin by product, brand, class and category to support informed recommendations.

### **Customer\-Facing Interaction**

* Collaborate with Inventory/Demand Planners and Buyers to optimise inventory management.
* Engage with ZURU's VP of Sales, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams to keep the business aligned.
* Present sales, operations and financial data to the retailer's team during key meetings.

### **Support**

* Support Sales in Line Review, JBP, forecasting and Buyer's meeting preparation.
* Address requests from Sales, Commercial and Marketing teams regarding POS information.
* Prepare and distribute accurate weekly and monthly POS reports, reviewing them with specific sales teams to surface actionable insights.

### **Design \& Innovation**

* Identify opportunities for improved efficiency and more timely communication of business performance.
* Document key processes and best practices for sharing across teams.
* Map inefficiencies and waste, then propose and implement scalable solutions.

*The annual salary range for this position is $75,000 \- $80,000\.*

*Please note this role is based in\-person in our LA office.*

**What You'll Gain**
--------------------

* Real ownership of retailer\-level analysis from the start \- your forecasts, P\&Ls and insights will be used by senior leaders to make commercial decisions, not filed away.
* Direct exposure to retail customers and to ZURU's Sales, Commercial, Marketing and Operations teams, building the commercial judgement and stakeholder skills that take most analysts years to develop.
* Hands\-on development of your analytical toolkit \- SQL, data visualisation, forecasting and P\&L analysis.
* Exposure to an ever\-expanding and far\-reaching business across a wide variety of sectors and industry groups, giving you a first\-hand view of market practices, challenges and trends, and how data drives decisions across a global business.
* A clear runway to grow. As ZURU is on such a fast growth trajectory, high performers move quickly into broader scope and greater responsibility.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* A recent graduate (or approaching graduation) in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Statistics, Supply Chain, Mathematics or a related field .
* Working knowledge of Excel and SQL, with familiarity across data visualisation, statistical analysis, Python and ETL practices.
* Strong commercial curiosity \- you enjoy working out the "so what" behind the numbers, not just producing them.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present findings to senior stakeholders and external customers.
* Sharp attention to detail and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets.
* A go\-getter with energy, creativity and determination to continuously improve and push boundaries.

**Why ZURU is right for you**


ZURU moves fast, thinks big, and sets ambitious goals. We're not your typical 9\-to\-5\. Our teams are made up of talented people who enjoy solving complex problems, taking ownership, and continuously raising the bar. If you're excited by making a real impact, learning at pace, and being surrounded by people who challenge you to grow, you'll likely thrive at ZURU.

**ZURU's approach to ways of working**


We believe the best ideas come from working closely together. Our teams adopt an office\-first mindset enabling fast collaboration, quicker decision\-making, and stronger team connections. While flexibility may be available depending on the role, location and business needs, most positions are based in the office, where we can innovate, learn from one another, and move quickly as a team.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, New Verticals
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



At DoorDash we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three\-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and dashers. TPMs on our Engineering teams provide fundamental support to the underlying technology services as well as the engineers building these services. It's no simple task, but it wouldn't be interesting if it was!


**About the Role**
------------------



New Verticals is building the future of local commerce at DoorDash: making the city shoppable by helping consumers get groceries, convenience items, retail products, and more with the quality, speed, and affordability they expect. The organization operates at significant scale and is expanding beyond the core marketplace into new fulfillment models and merchant\-facing products. Our work spans the consumer shopping experience, catalog and inventory, pricing and affordability, fulfillment, merchant integrations, and the platform capabilities that connect them.



Our team is looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to lead complex, high\-impact programs across New Verticals Engineering. This role sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations, helping translate ambitious business bets into executable technical strategies. You will work across Grocery, Convenience, Retail, DashMart Fulfillment Services, and emerging Merchant Services initiatives, where success requires navigating deeply interconnected systems, evolving product requirements, and dependencies across multiple DoorDash organizations. You will bring strong technical judgment, create clarity in ambiguous spaces, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive programs from strategy through launch and scale.



You will report into the centralized Technical Program Management team in Engineering. You must be located in either the San Francisco Bay Area or Seattle.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* **Drive New Verticals' Most Strategic Programs \-** You will partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership, Strategy \& Operations, and cross\-functional teams to turn New Verticals' strategy into executable technical programs. The portfolio spans growing Grocery and Convenience, scaling Retail selection and shopping experiences, evolving DashMart Fulfillment Services, and building new Merchant Services capabilities.
* **Lead Complex Cross\-Organization Execution \-** New Verticals depends on capabilities across consumer experience, catalog and inventory, pricing and promotions, logistics, merchant integrations, ads, and platform infrastructure. You will establish clear ownership and milestones, surface critical dependencies and tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams when the path forward is not obvious.
* **Bring Technical Depth and Systems Thinking** \- You will develop a deep understanding of the architecture, data flows, and operational systems behind New Verticals. You will engage in technical designs, identify scaling and reliability risks, understand how decisions in one part of the system affect the end\-to\-end customer and merchant experience, and help teams make pragmatic tradeoffs.
* **Turn Ambiguity into Strategy and Action** \- Many of our hardest problems do not begin with a clean scope or a single owner. You will truth\-seek across technical and business inputs, frame the problem, clarify the definition of success, develop a point of view on risks and options, and create an execution path that teams and leaders can align behind.
* **Connect Engineering Execution to Business Outcomes \-** You will understand the customer, merchant, and economic outcomes behind the work and use that context to guide prioritization and execution. Whether the goal is improving speed and quality, expanding selection, making shopping easier, or improving cost to serve, you will help teams stay focused on the technical work that matters most to the business.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You're experienced in working with large\-scale distributed systems, as well as client\-side and platform teams, who own Tier 0 services serving external customers. You can speak to system architecture, scalability and reliability decisions, and design trade offs.
* You're a strong leader with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organizations, bridge gaps between teams, and successfully influence without authority.
* You have strong ownership, urgency, and drive. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and dive into the details to understand and drive your programs.
* You have excellent written \& verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate with confidence, clarity, and focus. You can convey concepts and considerations to non\-experts and experts alike.
* You've engaged with Engineering teams on product \& platform development with a thorough understanding of software development processes and project planning.
* You are pragmatic and detailed in your approach and focus on progress, not perfection.


**Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's Degree with experience in Computer Science, Software Engineering or other related discipline.
* 8\+ years recent experience as a Technical Program Manager at a technology company.
* Experience in large\-scale distributed systems and system architecture.
* Experience working with full\-stack engineers and directly engaging on product development, with a thorough understanding of software development processes.
* Project planning and execution skills that include reviewing technical design documents, estimating, and scheduling.

jobs.description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6\.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short\-Term Disability \+ Baby Bonding): 28\-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year


Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with data analysis, bug fixing, and utilizing tracking tools such as business intelligence platform and bug dashboards to resolve operational issues.
* Experience in technical program management, requirements gathering, and stakeholder management related to physical security systems, compliance, and data center architecture.
* Experience utilizing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage preventative maintenance and workflow automation.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience mapping electronic security systems to security controls.
* Experience maintaining technology in security environments.
* Experience maintaining and upgrading one or more of the following systems: access Control, badging and credential technology, Identity and PAM, video surveillance, high security intrusion detection, physical security networking, physical security servers and infrastructure.
* Experience leading and managing technology projects in all phases, from evaluation to design and execution.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


The CSRM\-Technical Operations Safety Platforms, Architectures and Concept Engineering (SPACE) team is looking for an innovative and technically\-driven Technical Program Manager to join our team sustaining the electronic security and safety systems in our data center fleet. You will get to exercise all your physical security systems expertise, and system administration knowledge to make Google data centers a safer and more operationally sound place to work.


In this role, you will own the logical administration, remote maintenance strategy, and lifecycle standards of physical security devices across our entire data center fleet. You will architect global lifecycle and firmware maintenance programs and drive remote support performance to ensure zero operational downtime. By leveraging health telemetry and building strong cross\-functional partnerships, you will directly influence how our physical security systems are maintained and secured while reducing the fleet’s overall risk profile.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $163000 \- $236000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Engage with cross\-functional teams (site operations, compliance, and engineering) to optimize logical configurations and platform integrity for physical security systems, streamlining remote programming and change management.
* Drive global standardization of system programming, configuration settings, and diagnostic workflows for physical security infrastructure (e.g., access control, CCTV) to ensure consistent remote commissioning and breakfix execution.
* Develop and monitor performance KPIs for system uptime and resolution efficiency, while designing telemetry dashboards to enhance remote diagnostic tools and provide real\-time visibility into device health.
* Architect and manage a remote support SLA framework, holding internal support tiers and third\-party integration partners to strict Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) and quality\-of\-repair targets globally.
* Lead technical root\-cause analysis (RCA) for major system outages by leveraging device event logs, network packet captures, and telemetry data to prevent repeat incidents and address systemic vulnerabilities.

* Apply technical acumen and strategic program management principles to establish the initial framework for success, focusing on rapid value delivery and organizational change readiness.

* Optimize cross\-team processes and workflows to improve operational efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and delivery outcomes for AI\-related initiatives.

* May telecommute.

	+ Supporting AI enablement initiatives, including foundational planning, stakeholder alignment, governance strategy development, and operational readiness for large\-scale technology adoption;
	+ Process optimization and operational excellence, including identifying inefficiencies and designing scalable processes to improve delivery, adoption, and organizational effectiveness;

**About Paradigm**


Paradigm is a new type of spreadsheet for automating manual research with agents. We are based in San Francisco and are backed by \~$10M from General Catalyst, Y Combinator, and some of the best builders and operators in technology, including the founders of Ramp, Dropbox, and more.


Our team is small and talent\-dense. We are serial builders who have worked and studied at Google, Databricks, Penn, Bridgewater, and more.


The spreadsheet interface is just the beginning. Our mission is to build a new type of agent\-centric workspace that massively increases the productivity of knowledge workers. If you want to work on frontier AI systems that tackle meaningful real\-world challenges and push the boundaries of what intelligent software can do, apply to join us.

**About the Role**


We're looking for an exceptional operator to help every Paradigm customer succeed, starting by taking the operational load off our founding team and growing into full account ownership.


Today, our largest customer accounts are run hands\-on by our founding team and include: bespoke onboarding, negotiated pilot success criteria, and expansion conversations built on real relationships. You'll come in and immediately own the operational backbone of customer success, then grow into owning accounts yourself.


We're looking for someone with the ability to own major enterprise relationships and the humility to start by making the current motion run better. No two weeks will look the same, and we're looking for someone who takes pride in making sure nothing falls through the cracks.


As Paradigm grows, this role will naturally evolve alongside the company, with opportunities to expand into full account ownership, broader customer success, or people and operations roles.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own onboarding logistics for new pilots, including kickoff scheduling, account setup, and getting customer teams productive fast
* Track every pilot against its agreed success criteria and flag risks early
* Serve as first\-line triage for customer questions and issues, resolving what you can and escalating what you can't so nothing slips
* Keep customer records, usage data, and account health visible and up to date
* Build the repeatable playbooks and templates that turn our bespoke motion into something scalable
* Grow into owning a book of accounts, leading check\-ins, renewals, and the customer relationship end\-to\-end
* Deeply understand each customer's data pain points and priorities, and identify the best use cases and teams to expand Paradigm within large enterprises
* Partner on expansion, spotting where customers can get more value and driving upsell conversations across layered buying organizations

**Requirements for the role…**

* Experience in a client\-facing role such as consulting, deployed engineering, account management, implementation, customer success, or operations
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable with sophisticated enterprise customers
* A fast learner who can get genuinely fluent in a technical product and explain it clearly
* Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle confidential customer information
* High comfort operating in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where priorities shift frequently
* A proactive, low\-ego sense of ownership, willing to do the operational work that needs doing now while growing into more
* Willingness to travel

**You might excel if you...**

* Have successfully been a part of complex enterprise teams, especially sourcing and managing account growth
* Have worked as a software engineer, SE, technical account manager or other technical role
* Take pride in being the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Get satisfaction from turning a messy, bespoke motion into clean, repeatable playbooks
* Can get genuinely fluent in a technical product and explain it clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Are energized by fast\-paced, ambiguous environments where priorities shift week to week

**What we believe...**


Our best work is done in person. The team works together 5 days a week in our office in SF.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Social Impact

The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is seeking a Project Manager to join our Program Management Office. The Project Manager has overall responsibility for managing scope, budgets, timelines, project teams, stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables across multiple projects that improve the lives of people living with diabetes. Reporting to the Program Director, this role supports the PMO in standardizing project management processes (with a focus on efficiency), ensuring strategic alignment and effective program delivery, and fostering collaboration across teams. The Project Manager will support ADA mission\-driven success on PMO initiatives and programs while promoting accountability and impact.

  


**Responsibilities**


* Leads cross\-functional teams to deliver projects on time and within budget
* Aligns resources to accomplish project tasks and key milestones with clear accountability for project deliverables
* Communicates and collaborates with development and marketing teams to provide training and information required to promote and seek funding for new projects, programs, and systems.
* Directs the work of a project team with overall responsibility for managing scope, budget, timeline, staffing and stakeholders, vendors, and contractual deliverables.
* Accountable for project deliverables, overall project success, and supporting contract renewals to expand ADA’s offerings.
* Serves as a liaison between internal and external stakeholders, volunteers, customers, and vendors.
* Maintains process documentation and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement for all organization initiatives.
* Facilitates quality management and change management techniques for project management.
* Effectively estimates and plans project resources, schedules, and budgets.

  


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree required
* Minimum expected years of relevant experience: 5 years in project management and/or delivery of programs, products, or services
* Project Management Professional (PMP)® certification is preferred
* Understanding of project management methodologies, such as PMBOK
* Demonstrated proficiency in project management software (e.g. MS Project or Smartsheets)

  


**Skills**


* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong sense of urgency
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to form and lead high\-performing teams
* Critical thinking and the ability to manage complex projects
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills
* Strong change management skills
* Demonstrates a high level of personal accountability and holds others accountable for results
* Fosters collaboration and cooperation to deliver results
* Strong planning, organization, and attention to detail
* Good negotiation skills
* Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work independently to manage multiple concurrent projects

  


**Why Work Here**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work\-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:


* Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
* A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
* Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability \& life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
* Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program

* Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well\-being of millions

  


**About the Organization**  

The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

Ting Labs is the company behind Ting, an electrical fire prevention sensor active in more than 1\.3 million homes across North America. A single Ting sensor takes 30 million measurements per second; across the fleet, the result is one of the largest continuous, high\-resolution datasets ever assembled on the residential electrical grid.

  

Ting’s sensor fleet captures, in real time, what is actually happening on the grid downstream of grid\-side sensors. Utility operations and planning teams can use this distributed telemetry to improve the reliability and resilience of an electrical grid under unprecedented pressure.
